extensionDescription.message: Tracks the page you're reading so Luna can save it.
extensionDescription.description: Description shown in Safari extension settings.

unlockedWithLuna.description: Toast shown after Luna removes a page's reading obstruction.

openingLuna.description: Temporary button label while the containing app opens.

readInLuna.description: Button that opens an article in Luna Reader.

downloadInLuna.description: Button that opens this video in Luna.

trackInLuna.description: Button that adds a product to Luna Price Tracker.

closeVideo.description: Accessibility label for the in-page player's X button.

setupCompleteTitle.description: Confirmation shown in the page the first time the extension runs after setup was started in the app. The line break is deliberate.

returnToApp.description: Button that reopens the containing app after setup. {app} is substituted by content.js with that app's own name, e.g. 'Luna Reader'. It is deliberately NOT written $APP$ -- see the note in content.js.

wasPriceOnDate.description: Informational-on-tap pill showing a lower historical price; it also supports a long-press drag. {price} and {date} are substituted by content.js. Deliberately NOT written $PRICE$/$DATE$ -- see the note in content.js.

findingSellers.description: Pill shown while the native handler looks for the same product on other retailers' sites.

priceAtSeller.description: Tappable pill naming a cheaper current price on another retailer; tapping it opens that seller's page. {price} and {seller} are substituted by content.js. Deliberately NOT written $PRICE$/$SELLER$ -- see the note in content.js.

noBetterPrice.description: Non-interactive pill state after the alternative-seller lookup completed and found nothing cheaper. Replaces the 'Finding other sellers…' spinner in place.

sellerLookupFailed.description: Non-interactive pill state when the alternative-seller lookup itself failed (the native side never answered, or the round trip was rejected) -- distinct from a completed search that found nothing.

videoPlaybackFailed.message: Safari couldn’t play this video. You can open it in Luna.
